card1993nber.note: NBER WP 4483, October 1993 (title page and abstract page). 37-page scan without a text layer: OCR'd with tesseract at 300 dpi; every number in sources/notes.md from Tables 1-5 (PDF pp. 33-37) was read from the page images, not from OCR. Metadata confirmed on Crossref (DOI 10.3386/w4483, Card, 1993-10). This is the version whose tables are quoted.

card1995chapter.note: The chapter text was NOT reachable. Verified only bibliographically: the volume (title, editors Christofides/Grant/Swidinsky, University of Toronto Press, Toronto; Buffalo, 1995, xv+286 pp., ISBN 0802028640) from the ECU library catalogue record; the chapter page range 201-222 from two fetched secondary references (Blandhol et al. 2025 reference list; rdocumentation wooldridge::card). The claim that the chapter has 'the same title and identical tables' is Card's own, in code_bk.txt of proximity.zip; it is not checked. Cite for the published version only; every number comes from card1993nber.

card1994earnings.note: Downloaded and OCR'd: title 'Earnings, Schooling, and Ability Revisited', NBER WP 4832, August 1994 (PDF pp. 1-2); Crossref agrees. Recorded only to document that the codebook's and the seed brief's citation 'NBER Working Paper 4832, August 1994' for the proximity paper is wrong; the proximity paper is WP 4483.

cardproximitydata.note: Downloaded 2026-11-20 to the scout scratchpad (sha256 of the zip 0e9b2ad4182ea631ca3dd8a5fff6c1b0ab86b56c6a3fa868870f716e8d82691f; contents code_bk.txt, nls.dat, read1.lst, read1.sas, readme, all dated 2002-05-30). Read readme, code_bk.txt and read1.sas only. nls.dat was not opened and read1.lst was opened only to identify it (SAS listing of read1.sas output). No licence statement in the zip.

kling2001interpreting.note: Full text read is the NBER WP 7989 version (October 2000, 28 pp.); journal metadata (JBES 19(3), 358-364, July 2001) from Crossref. Numbers quoted (Table 1, section 3) are from the WP; the journal version was not seen.

blandhol2025tsls.note: NBER WP 29709 revised January 2025; section 6.1, Table 3 and Tables SA.3-SA.4 read from pdftotext. A Review of Economic Studies manuscript version exists (restud.com) and was not read.

bi2020inferring.note: arXiv v1, 14 March 2020; section 6.1 and its Table 1 read. No journal version found on Crossref.

kang2021ivmodel.note: Full text read is arXiv v2 (8 July 2020, 24 pp.); section 7 (Card application) read. Journal metadata (Observational Studies 7(2), 1-24, 2021) from Crossref.

ivmodelscard.note: Software documentation page (Python ivmodels), read via WebFetch. No author or version printed on the page; repository github.com/mlondschien/ivmodels. Uses an over-identified instrument set, not nearc4 alone. The same example and numbers appear in Londschien (2025) (londschien2025guide), so the page is Londschien's ivmodels documentation.

wooldridgecarddata.note: Dataset documentation page: 3010 obs, 34 variables, exper = age - educ - 6, source Card (1995) pp. 201-222.

kitagawa2015test.note: Abstract page only (full text behind login). The abstract does not mention the Card application; its result on Card's instrument is known here only through carr2021testing (secondary).

carr2021testing.note: arXiv v1, 9 December 2021; abstract, introduction and section 5.1 read.

anderson1949estimation.note: DOI resolves to Project Euclid; metadata from Crossref. Full text not read; cite only as the origin of the AR statistic (the heteroskedasticity-robust form is described in andrews2019weak).

stock2002testing.note: NBER Technical WP 284, October 2002, 73 pp. Critical values read from Table 1 (TSLS bias, printed p. 58) and Table 2 (TSLS size, printed p. 59) via pdftotext.

stock2005testing.note: Published chapter metadata from Crossref (pp. 80-108, Cambridge UP, 2005). Text not read; the published table numbering (often cited as Table 5.2) is not verified. Numbers are quoted from stock2002testing.

montielolea2013robust.note: Author-hosted final manuscript (dated April 2013, 39 pp.). The DOI (Crossref; resolves to tandfonline) carries a Technometrics-style prefix but is the JBES 31(3) 358-369 article. Critical values from Table 1 and pp. 2-10 of the manuscript; the journal typeset version was not seen.

andrews2019weak.note: Accepted manuscript dated 20 November 2018 (41 pp.) from NSF PAR; recommendations on p. 3 and sections 4-5 read. Journal metadata from Crossref.

conley2012plausibly.note: Full text read is the 31 July 2008 draft (48 pp.); section 4.1 (union of confidence intervals) and section 6.3 read. Journal metadata (REStat 94(1), 260-272, Feb 2012) from Crossref; the published text was not seen.

clarke2018practical.note: Stata Journal 18(3), 663-691 (from the article's first page). Full text downloaded; the abstract was read and the text searched: it introduces plausexog (CHR 2012) and imperfectiv (Nevo-Rosen 2012) and contains no match for 'card' or 'proximity', so it does not use Card's data.

lee2022valid.note: Full text read is arXiv v1 (15 October 2020). The 104.7 and 3.43 values are from its abstract and Results 2b/2c; journal metadata (AER 112(10), 3260-3290) from Crossref; the published version was not compared.

cinelli2025omitted.note: NSF PAR accepted manuscript (19 pp.), read via pdftotext: sec. 2 (Card running example, n = 3,010, PDF p. 3-5), classical homoskedastic SEs (p. 6), sec. 5 and Table 2 'Minimal sensitivity reporting' (PDF p. 15-16), Fig. 1 (p. 17). Metadata (Biometrika 112(2), article asaf004, 2025) from Crossref and the NSF PAR record par.nsf.gov/biblio/10614775. The manuscript text gives the covariates only as 'race, experience, and a set of regional factors'; the exact list comes from the vignette (ivsensemakr). Typeset version and Supplementary Material not read.

ivsensemakr.note: Package vignette dated 2026-02-09, read via WebFetch (first 100,000 of 217,129 characters, which contain the Card model code and output). Gives covariates exper, expersq, black, south, smsa, reg661-reg668, smsa66; OLS 0.07469326; AR CI [0.025, 0.285]; RV 0.00667; XRV 0.000523; bounds for 1x black and 1x smsa. CRAN DOI 10.32614/CRAN.package.iv.sensemakr from Crossref.

londschien2025guide.note: arXiv v1, 17 August 2025, 83 pp.; sec. 2.1 (PDF p. 4), 3.1, 4 (tests at beta = 0, PDF p. 18), 6 (confidence sets, PDF p. 29) read. Numbers identical to the ivmodels documentation page (ivmodelscard). No journal version found.

steiner2025possibilistic.note: arXiv v3, 3 July 2026; sec. 5.3 and Table 5 read via pdftotext. Crossref finds no published version.

delbianco2026testing.note: arXiv v2, 10 September 2026; abstract, sec. 5 and Table 2 read. Crossref finds no published version.

sloczynski2024abadie.note: arXiv v4, 28 February 2024; sec. 4.2 and Table 3 read. Crossref lists only SSRN versions (10.2139/ssrn.4114817); a journal version was not checked.
